name: UI Theme Plugin
description: Legacy-compatible theme packages, built-in themes, theme manager workflow, and exact-version Cubism appearance application.

permissions.reason: Registers theme manager, package import/export, delete, and status actions.
Reads the selected theme package from plugin-owned typed configuration.
Persists the selected theme package after a successful host appearance apply.
Reads the SDK theme status snapshot through the project-scoped Cubism read capability.
Shows the unified theme selection window and bounded package workflow dialogs.
Requests opaque ZIP theme package handles for import and export.
Reads bounded theme archives from plugin storage and granted import handles.
Atomically stores, deletes, and exports bounded theme archives.
Shows theme package status, import progress, and appearance apply results.
Applies or restores a reviewed built-in theme through the semantic appearance service.
